title: LeaveHub — Leave Management
description: Role-aware leave management system with multi-step approvals, transactional balance calculations, accrual and carry-over policies, country holidays, team calendars, reports, 2FA, audit logs and GDPR tools. Built with Laravel, Inertia, React and MySQL.
features: Multi-level leave approvals with role-based employee and manager experiences
Transactional leave balances, accrual, carry-forward and country holiday calculations
Team calendar, absence reports, exports and personal calendar feeds
Audit trail, two-factor authentication and GDPR-oriented employee handling
workflow: Create request and calculate eligible working days
Apply leave policy and route through configurable approvals
Notify stakeholders and expose reports and calendar views
summary: Role-aware leave management with multi-step approvals, transactional balance calculations, accrual and carry-over policies, country holidays, team calendars, reports, 2FA, audit logs and GDPR tools.
